_about: Which of the export's option groups offer dishes rather than words, by the group's name in the export. "items_from": each option becomes the dish of the same name in that category (an option with no such dish, like No Soup, stays a plain option). "category": the group offers every dish on sale in that category instead of the export's own copies of them, and follows the category from then on: a new roll is in the maki combination the moment it is on the menu. A choice that is a dish prints at the dish's station under the dish it came with, carries the dish's own choices, and shows on the check as its own line. Edit and run `hubctl update`; a running hub takes the change with `hubctl menu import --apply`.
